title: Use Omni Reference with 2 input images (character portraits) to lock character…
content:
Use Omni Reference with 2 input images (character portraits) to lock character identity in Dreamina Seedance.  
Use an Auteur Brief prompt format and add an Opening Section plus BLOCK/STATE tags to better control scene blocking and character state.
